GENERICMESSAGE::route
Description

lookup message routes.

GENERICMESSAGE::route add [src <src_addr>] [dst <dst_addr>] peer <peer> [peer <peer>]*
Adds a route to the current instance that the iRule context is
running in. (Note both ‘src’ and ‘source’ are acceptable. Likewise
‘dst’, ‘dest’ and ‘destination’ are acceptable).
GENERICMESSAGE::route delete [src <src_addr>] [dst <dst_addr>]
Deletes a route from the current instance that the iRule context is
running in. (Note both ‘src’ and ‘source’ are acceptable. Likewise
‘dst’, ‘dest’ and ‘destination’ are acceptable).
GENERICMESSAGE::route lookup [src <src_addr>] [dst <dst_addr>]
Returns a route matching the specified source address and destination
address in the instance that the iRule context is running in. (Note
both ‘src’ and ‘source’ are acceptable. Likewise ‘dst’, ‘dest’ and
‘destination’ are acceptable).
